chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from ʿAbd al-Karim ibn ʿAmr, from Saʿid ibn Yasar, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about one who bought a sheep and did not announce it. So he said: “There is no harm; whether he announced it or did not announce it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يُعَرِّفْ: to announce or make known publicly

ai.seo_question: Is it necessary to announce a sheep after purchasing it for sacrificial purposes?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who buys a sheep and does not publicly announce it. Imam Abu ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that there is no harm in either announcing it or leaving it unannounced, indicating permissibility in both cases.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3068 - Al-Bazanti narrated from Abdul Karim ibn Amr from Saeed ibn Yasar, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about someone who buys a sheep but does not announce it (as a sacrifice).
Imam (as) replied: "There is no harm whether he announces it or does not announce it."
